purpose.zh: 练单腿站时髋部的转动控制
purpose.en: Train hip control for turning while standing on one leg.

text.zh: 骨盆和上身一起，慢慢转开
text.en: Turn your hips and chest together, slowly opening up

text.zh: 单腿站稳，膝盖微弯，一只手轻扶椅子。
text.en: Stand on one leg, knee soft, one hand lightly on the chair.

text.zh: 小幅度转开再转回，腰别单独扭。
text.en: Open a little, then turn back, without twisting at the waist.

commonErrors.en: Twisting the waist instead of turning at the hip.
Letting the standing knee cave in.

cautions.zh: 扶稳没有轮子的椅子，疼或站不稳时就停
cautions.en: Use a stable chair without wheels, and stop if it hurts or you feel unsteady.

changes: 节奏按 spec 时间轴手算（派生值把 90% 以上都算停顿，和 spec 不符）：转 1.5/停 1.5/回 2.5/歇 2.5 s（派生 0.9/2.3/1.5/3.4）
主口令去「绕支撑髋」；口令「回正」→「慢慢转回」
